title: Sheng Er Wei Mao
synopsis:
High-level hunters always appear as prey—when people think they've won over the adorable cats and feel smug, their hearts have already been completely captured! That's right, the story begins with a cat-loving family consisting of a goofy dad—Cai Ge, a dramatic mom—Mi'er, their daughter—Xiao Xiao Cai, and their three cats (the domineering CEO—Rou Zong, the master of cat-taming—A Juan, and the rice-eating king—Deng Deng)! Living with cats is full of surprises. 

Facing the double whammy of the child and the felines, Cai Ge and Mi'er experience a vibrant life of both joy and sorrow, torment and pleasure! And so, with their unique way of thinking, the Cai family of three gradually transforms from novice cat owners into top-tier cat lovers who dominate the neighborhood. Humans and cats constantly "harm" each other, leading to a series of hilarious situations! Want to know how the three adorable cats conquer their owners? And how the three Cai family members will cope? Come witness "Born to be a Cat"!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
